conviction_note: The findings sum to +1.5 on a likely full-year raise plus a dividend bump, which this company did at last year's H1 (+4.99% next day). That is partly offset by a visible Q2 slowdown in the 月次 against a peak quarter last year. The single-analyst IFIS consensus already sits above the company plan, so the scaled number (+0.45 = (2*0.57-1)*3.2) is well below the findings sum: the raise is expected and only its size is in question.

Source: https://kabuyoho.ifis.co.jp/index.php?action=tp1&sa=report_chg&bcode=9861 (updated 2026-10-07). positioning_check: JPX short register: no disclosed position >=0.5%, unchanged (as_of 2026-09-29, baseline, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用倍率 0.38 (baseline). The margin-short side is dominated by 株主優待 cross trades around the Feb/Aug record dates (irbank shows the margin short balance swinging from 0.1m to 2.1m shares around Feb 2026: https://irbank.net/9861/margin), so it is not squeeze fuel. findings.finding: The full-year forecast is very likely raised at this print. Q1 OP of 2,544m is already 55% of the H1 OP plan (4,600m) and 30% of the FY plan (8,500m). The plan implies Q2 OP of about 2,056m against 3,382m in Q2 last year. It also assumes a 38.9% cost-of-sales ratio against 37.6% actual in Q1. Last year at H1 the company raised FY 経常 from 8.0bn to 8.7bn.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-09 H1: FY 経常 +8.8% raise with dividend +2 yen, next-session move +4.99% (baseline; kabutan k202510090039). 2026-07-08 Q1: OP 2.4x with the plan held, next close +0.96% (Yahoo closes 3329 -> 3361).
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced. The IFIS consensus (FY 経常 10.1bn) already sits 15% above the company plan, and the stock is at 49x company EPS. If the market expected a raise well above 10bn, the stock would not have faded 5% from its 2026-09-01 close of 3,876 into the print. What is left is the size of the raise against the 10.1bn consensus.
findings.independence: Separate document: last year's same-quarter raise, https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=9861&b=k202510090039 (2025-10-09). The Q1 supplementary materials confirm the 38.9% FY cost ratio: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260708/140120260708589385.pdf

findings.finding: A dividend increase at H1 is plausible again. Last year the company raised the annual dividend from 20 to 22 yen alongside its H1 raise; this year's plan holds 22 yen while plan EPS is 75.71 yen, and actual earnings are running well ahead of plan.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-09: the dividend +2 yen came together with the guide raise, for a +4.99% combined move. It cannot be separated from the guide.
findings.why_not_priced: Small. The yield is 0.59%, so 2 yen barely moves the valuation; it matters as a retail signal in a 優待-heavy register. No source shows the market expecting it.
findings.independence: The Q1 tanshin dividend table shows the 22-yen plan unchanged: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260708/140120260707589069.pdf

findings.finding: Q2 (Jun-Aug) existing-store sales at Yoshinoya slowed to about +2.5% (Jun 100.4, Jul 106.5, Aug 100.7) with customers about -1.1%, against +13.6% in Q2 last year. Last year's Q2 was a peak quarter at a 5.8% OP margin, so Q2 OP is at risk of coming in flat to down, against an IFIS H1 consensus that implies Q2 経常 roughly flat on last year's 3.56bn.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Q1 quarter beat with no guide change bought only +0.96% to the next close (2026-07-08 -> 07-09).
findings.source_date: 2026-10-08 (page fetched; the monthly figures were published progressively Jul-Oct 2026)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The monthly figures are public, and the stock fell from 3,876 (2026-09-01) to 3,690 after the August figure. What may be unpriced is the margin on the slower sales, which the monthly figures do not show.
findings.independence: Last year's monthly figures for the comparison: https://www.yoshinoya-holdings.com/file/ir/report/report_2025.pdf. Last year's Q2 OP of 3,382m and 5.8% margin: https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=9861

findings.finding: September (the first month of Q3) existing-store sales were +10.1% with customers +4.3%, a re-acceleration that gives the company cover to raise its H2 outlook rather than repeat last year's H2 decline.
findings.why_not_priced: Released recently. The stock is only +1% from its late-September low, so the September re-acceleration is not obviously in the price. The figure is public, though, so it is a support for the guide finding and not an edge on its own.
findings.independence: Shares a document with the Q2 monthly finding (same page, different months).

findings.finding: The Kizuki International (US ramen chain, 17 stores, 70% for $28.7m) acquisition closed on 2026-09-02. Its FY impact was 'under review' and may be folded into a revised guide, adding sales but little OP after goodwill.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The announcement on 2026-07-10, together with the buyback, preceded a +5.3% session on 07-13.
findings.why_not_priced: Immaterial to group OP; it is filed because it may appear in the revised guide.
